text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's about time for training, and I'm looking for Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, I just can't get one in. It must be how I'm snapping my wrist.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh… I'm sorry, Trainer. Is it time for our training session?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Practicing free throws. I'll be taking part in a basketball game with my classmates soon.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And no matter the contest, losing is not an option for me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So I'm sorry, but I do have five minutes until training, correct?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's not wrong, so I wait as she spends those last five minutes practicing furiously. By the end of our actual training, she's completely wiped.
